findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router status reports router is reachable but call_log_exists is false and log_file does not exist

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router creates and populates call_log.jsonl on startup and execution to enable auditability and latency tracking

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into router operations, request metrics, and failure rates

findings.title: Direct provider API calls bypassing model router in emergency alert processing

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral via environment variables bypassing model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert calls to route through the centralized model router endpoint

findings.expected_benefit: Enforces unified model routing policy, fallback logic, rate limiting, and observability

findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 placeholders in research commands

evidence.observation: Multiple TODO comments indicating unimplemented Phase 5 functionality for Supabase authorization checking and decision memory integration

proposed_action.description: Implement Phase 5 authorization checking via Supabase and integration with decision_to_memory

findings.expected_benefit: Completes intended research lifecycle security and state tracking

findings.title: Unimplemented quality anomaly querying in forecasting runtime

evidence.observation: Hardcoded empty list with TODO comment: 'recent_anomalies = [] # TODO: Query quality_anomalies table'

proposed_action.description: Implement query logic to retrieve records from the quality_anomalies table instead of returning a stub

findings.expected_benefit: Enables accurate quality forecasting based on actual recorded anomalies
